title: Factory Droid Skill Format
description: JSON Schema for Factory Droid Skills - SKILL.md files stored in .factory/skills/<skill-name>/

name.description: Unique identifier for the skill (kebab-case recommended)

description.description: Brief explanation of what the skill does and when to use it

allowed-tools.description: Reserved for future use. Safe to omit.

content.description: Skill workflow and instructions as markdown

frontmatter.name: api-integration
frontmatter.description: Integrate a new API endpoint with proper error handling

examples.content:
# API Integration Skill

## Steps

1. Define the API endpoint specification
2. Create the service layer function
3. Add error handling and validation
4. Write unit tests
5. Update API documentation

## Success Criteria

- All tests pass
- Error handling covers edge cases
- Documentation is updated
